default_rule: Two modes: 'shareable' (default) and 'internal' (explicit argument, banner, contains_row_level_data: true, file name suffix _INTERNAL)
source_or_evidence: Catalogue L6-13; GDPR Recital 26: pseudonymised data that can be attributed with additional information remain personal data
status: Recital text verified via reproductions (EUR-Lex blocked)

default_rule: Minimum count per displayed cell, bin or band: k = 10; counts 1 to k-1 shown as '<k'
source_or_evidence: ONS SRS applies a default low-count threshold of 10 (Feb 2025 guidance, via search); DfE uses the SRS default of 10; ACRO default safe_threshold 10

default_rule: k counts distinct data subjects (the declared disclosure unit, by default the person-level grouping factor such as pupil or participant), not rows; with trial-level data a bin of 10 rows can come from one participant. Add a dominance check: the two largest contributing subjects supply less than 90% of a bin's rows
source_or_evidence: SDC thresholds count statistical units (ONS SRS, SDC Handbook); dominance parameters mirror ACRO's safe_nk_n = 2 and safe_nk_k = 0.90, which ACRO applies to magnitude tables; applying them to row contributions is my inference

default_rule: Secondary protection when a cell is suppressed: suppress complementary cells or round margins (base 5) so suppressed values cannot be recovered by differencing
source_or_evidence: Catalogue L6-13 verifier (differencing); ACRO safe_round_base 5

default_rule: Zeros in cross-tabs of person attributes treated as potentially disclosive; structural design zeros (for example counterbalancing) reported
source_or_evidence: ACRO default zeros_are_disclosive True

default_rule: No individual points, minima, maxima or outliers in shareable figures; extremes reported as counts; outer bins open-ended
source_or_evidence: ONS SRS guidance: scatter points typically represent one data subject, binned scatter graphs generally non-disclosive, outliers generally not permitted (via search); UK SDC Handbook v2.0: graphs follow the same principles as tables, scatter plots generally disclosive (via search); ACRO flags bin-edge disclosure

default_rule: Rasterising is not a privacy control
source_or_evidence: Experiment C-E18: from a 4.3 KB, 100-dpi PNG the five most extreme residuals were recovered within 0.17 to 0.26 units (axis range 80); SVG gave all 300 points exactly; plotly HTML gave exact values and all IDs

default_rule: SVG is used only for aggregated figures; point-level figures (internal mode) are PNG
source_or_evidence: matplotlib SVG writes one <use> element per observation in data order (C-E18); ACRO blocks .svg for custom outputs

default_rule: Pseudonymised labels (cluster 1, 2, ...) for flagged units; mapping kept in memory only; no file paths, user or host names in any output
source_or_evidence: Catalogue L6-13

default_rule: Banner: 'Shareable mode reduces disclosure risk; it does not make the report anonymous data. Check with your data protection officer and data provider.'
source_or_evidence: ICO anonymisation and pseudonymisation guidance (published 28 March 2025 per secondary sources): identifiability is a spectrum, assessed with a motivated-intruder test; Recital 38: children merit specific protection

default_rule: Target WCAG 2.2 level AA for the HTML report
source_or_evidence: UK public-sector accessibility monitoring has tested against WCAG 2.2 AA since October 2024 (GOV.UK, via search)

default_rule: Every figure: short alt text, a long description generated from the results and the aggregated data table
source_or_evidence: WCAG 1.1.1 (A); Understanding 1.1.1 'data chart' example: the long description gives the chart type, a high-level summary, trends and, where practical, the data in a table

default_rule: Severity and status never by colour alone: text label plus shape or icon
source_or_evidence: WCAG 1.4.1 (A)

default_rule: Palette for essential marks: blue #0072B2, vermillion #D55E00, bluish green #009E73, reddish purple #CC79A7 and black, each >= 3:1 against white (and the four colours also against #121212); orange, sky blue, yellow and grey only for non-essential fills with outlines; figures drawn on white panels
source_or_evidence: WCAG 1.4.11 (AA) 3:1 for graphical objects against adjacent colours; computed ratios in C-E19

default_rule: Body text >= 4.5:1; semantic headings, lang attribute, page title, tables with th/scope and captions
Reflow at 320 CSS px with data tables scrolling inside their own container; text resizable to 200%; robust to text-spacing overrides
source_or_evidence: WCAG 1.4.10 (data tables excepted), 1.4.4, 1.4.12

default_rule: No interactive widgets in v1; native <details>/<summary> only for collapsible sections
source_or_evidence: Avoids WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.11, 2.5.8 and 4.1.2 obligations of custom widgets

default_rule: CI: axe-core scan and HTML validation of the rendered golden reports; for PDF via Quarto Typst with pdf-standard ua-1, Typst's own validation plus veraPDF
source_or_evidence: Quarto bundles axe-core 4.10.3 (1.10 changelog) and installs veraPDF (1.9 changelog); Typst fails to compile non-compliant PDF/UA-1 documents (Quarto docs)

default_rule: No default output path; examples and tests write to tempdir(); open the report only when interactive(); never start a browser in examples or tests; no network; templates shipped in inst/
source_or_evidence: CRAN Repository Policy (revision 6985 via the eddelbuettel/crp mirror): writes only to the session temporary directory, no external software such as browsers during examples or tests unless closed, Internet resources must fail gracefully, data and documentation generally under 5 MB

default_rule: Quarto only through Suggests: quarto (>= 1.5.0); render helper guarded by requireNamespace() and quarto_available(min = '1.9'); tests skip when Quarto is absent
source_or_evidence: quarto R package 1.5.0 added quarto_available(min, max, error); 1.5.1 NEWS records CRAN failures where Quarto was not installed
